reason: I buy dev tools only after checking Reddit, GitHub issues, and Twitter, and Loom is brand new — there's nothing to vet. As a solo developer I run one agent at a time, so sharing sessions across ten agents isn't a pain I have, and I won't hand an unknown vendor my credentials at $30/seat on launch day.
objection: No reviews anywhere — no Reddit threads, no GitHub issues, no Twitter takes — yet I'd be giving a brand-new local daemon my credentials across every agent before anyone I trust has vetted it.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from developers like me, plus proof the daemon is open source or auditable so I'm not locking my credentials into an unknown vendor.
